kpis.signal: Cœur métier MKS (semi vacuum/gas/flow), reprise FY25 portée par hausse demande semiconducteur
kpis.description_fr: CA division VSD : technologies vacuum (pression, flow, gas delivery) pour fabrication semi-conducteurs et applications industrielles spéciales. Plus gros segment (40% CA FY25).
kpis.description_en: VSD division revenue: vacuum technologies (pressure, flow, gas delivery) for semiconductor manufacturing and specialty industrial applications. Largest segment (40% FY25 revenue).

kpis.signal: Segment ex-Atotech (acquisition août 2022) le plus margé (54% gross profit FY25 vs 43% VSD)
kpis.description_fr: CA division MSD (ex-Atotech) : chimies spéciales pour électronique avancée (packaging, PCB, semi). Acquisition Atotech close août 2022, FY21 n/a, FY22 partiel (5 mois).
kpis.description_en: MSD division revenue (ex-Atotech): specialty chemistry for advanced electronics (packaging, PCB, semi). Atotech acquisition closed Aug 2022, FY21 n/a, FY22 partial (5 months).

kpis.signal: Segment stable ~1B$/an, lasers/optiques industriels et PCB, exposé à industrie cyclique
kpis.description_fr: CA division PSD : solutions photoniques (lasers, optiques précision, instruments) pour semi, industriels et recherche. Croissance plate sur 5 ans.
kpis.description_en: PSD division revenue: photonics solutions (lasers, precision optics, instruments) for semi, industrial and research markets. Flat growth over 5 years.

kpis.signal: Reprise FY25 portée par cycle semi favorable + intégration complète Atotech
kpis.description_fr: CA total MKS Instruments consolidé. Saut FY22 reflète l'acquisition Atotech (août 2022), pic FY25 avec retour cycle semi.
kpis.description_en: MKS Instruments total consolidated net revenues. FY22 jump reflects Atotech acquisition (Aug 2022), FY25 peak with semi cycle recovery.

kpis_story.description_fr: Vague advanced packaging (CoWoS, HBM, fan-out, chiplets) bénéficie MKS via vacuum, optics, chemistry Atotech. Acquisition Atotech 2022 anticipée. Cible doubling AP revenue 2024-2028.
kpis_story.description_en: Advanced packaging wave (CoWoS, HBM, fan-out, chiplets) benefits MKS via vacuum, optics, Atotech chemistry. 2022 Atotech acquisition anticipated. Targets AP revenue doubling 2024-2028.

_notes: Semis equipment + advanced packaging. Source: 10-K FY24 filed Feb 2025.
